prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independent production concept reference for original warehouse digital twin 3D models.
Style: beautiful original boxy cartoon low-poly miniature. Strong cuboid primary masses, planar flat-shaded faces, small single-step bevels, matte surfaces. Tangible thickness, coherent connected construction, depth from clean silhouettes and gentle contact shadows. Charcoal #293D46, petrol teal #2E7376, warm tan #C99A60 and warm off-white environment palette. Clean blue/orange/purple/green/yellow uniforms reserved for people. Neutral light grey studio background, soft even light. Functional simplicity with carefully designed proportions. Avoid realistic textures, weathering, tiny bolts, smooth organic characters, thin stretched parts, floating disconnected components, extra limbs and visual clutter. No copyrighted characters or brands.

Primary request: modular conveyor and packing station reference sheet. Four clear sections: STRAIGHT, TURN, DIVERTER, PACK. STRAIGHT has substantial rectangular teal frame, real belt thickness/side guards and grounded legs. TURN is a supported ninety-degree transport path with a continuous joined corner surface, not two colliding straight strips. DIVERTER is a supported T-junction with visible transfer surface and three clear connection ends. PACK is a coherent sturdy table, scanner, small label printer, shallow open carton and a tape dispenser, with a short conveyor approach at matching work height. Separate foreground open tote and sealed parcel: tote visibly hollow, its useful interior exceeds the parcel in all three dimensions; parcel sits entirely inside without intersections. Show quarter views and small top path inset for each transport module. Person at pack is a square-headed original cartoon miniature in orange uniform, scale approximately1.70m. Real planar surfaces, chunky purposeful parts, no realistic mechanical clutter.

style_reference.role: Approved R01 art direction, viewed by executor; new R04 generated from its saved written prompt, not an edit target.

review.observed: Large cuboid frames/table/worker, planar matte teal/charcoal/tan masses and small bevels match the viewed R01 direction. No texture/weathering or tiny realistic mechanical clutter.
A thick black transport surface sits inside a substantial teal frame with attached longitudinal guards and grounded legs/feet. Main and smaller quarter illustrations use the same construction.

A supported continuous faceted curved deck joins two perpendicular open ends. Inner/outer guards follow the path; no pair of colliding straight belts is used. The top inset agrees with the quarter construction.

Three open connection ends meet on one visible transfer deck. The orange centre is uninterrupted by a transverse guard; separate branch and main surfaces join. Grounded legs support the branch and main span.

Worktop, lower shelf and legs are connected; short infeed abuts the table at a visually matching handling height. Scanner, printer, open shallow carton and tape dispenser are supported on the worktop.

Empty foreground tote has visible inner walls/floor, thick rim and handle openings. The separate fitted illustration places the parcel wholly inside the opening and below the rim, with visible side clearance; no wall intersection seen. This is visual clearance, not a dimensional validation.

Square-headed original orange packer provides an approximately 1.70m scale cue. Three transport modules have clear quarter views and matching top-path insets; labels identify the four requested sections.

limits: Family concept sheet, not a per-asset front/side/rear dimensional drawing.
The turn is depicted as a faceted curved continuous deck; final port anchors/centreline and topology follow future accepted layout metadata.
Approximate human height text and pictured clearances are not canonical engineering dimensions or capacities.
No geometry, export or runtime verification is claimed; root must view actual PNG before PASS.
